polls.description: Major Chinese tech giants Tencent and Alibaba are eyeing a massive $20+ billion investment in AI startup DeepSeek, signaling intense competition in the AI market.
polls.question: Is DeepSeek's $20B valuation justified or inflated?

cluster_stories.title: Tencent, Alibaba in Talks to Invest in DeepSeek at $20 Billion-Plus Valuation
cluster_stories.headline: TENCENT, ALIBABA Eye DeepSeek at $20B+ Valuation

cluster_stories.title: Tencent, Alibaba in talks to invest in DeepSeek at over $20 billion valuation: Report
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese tech giants Tencent and Alibaba are reportedly in talks to invest in AI startup DeepSeek. The company is aiming for a valuation exceeding twenty billion dollars. This potential funding highlights the significant capital needed for advanced AI development. Discussions are ongoing, and terms may change. DeepSeek's previous model release had a global impact.
cluster_stories.headline: TENCENT, ALIBABA Eye $20B DeepSeek Investment

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek in Talks to Raise at $20 Billion Value, Information Says
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese technology giants Tencent Holdings Ltd. and Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. are in discussions to invest funds into DeepSeek that would value the artificial intelligence startup above $20 billion, according to The Information.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK VALUED AT $20B... TENCENT & ALIBABA IN TALKS

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek targets $20bn valuation to stop poaching of staff
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese AI start-up is raising funds for first time to keep researchers after several defections to rivals
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK RAISES FUNDS AT $20BN TO STOP TALENT DRAIN

polls.description: Major Chinese AI company DeepSeek is raising funds at a $20 billion valuation with investment interest from tech giants Tencent and Alibaba.
